articles.title: EU-India FTA: Why Trust is India’s new strategic weapon in a 27-Nation Bloc?
articles.description: India’s Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with the European Union marks a significant step in strengthening economic ties between India and the 27-nation bloc. Built on trust, the rule of law and shared interests, the partnership could enhance trade, investment and India’s global economic standing. As geopolitical rivalries reshape global supply chains, trust is emerging as a strategic asset, much like rare earth minerals that power critical industries. The India–EU partnership highlights how collective strength, reliable institutions and deeper global integration can create a powerful multiplier for economic growth, resilience and long-term cooperation.
